# proxmox_backup_server_verify_job (Resource)

Manages a Proxmox Backup Server verification job via `/config/verify`. Removing this resource removes only the job configuration, not backups or the datastore. Schedules use the PBS server's time zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_backup_server_verify_job" "daily" {
  id              = "daily"
  store           = proxmox_backup_server_datastore.example.name
  schedule        = "09:00"
  ignore_verified = true
  outdated_after  = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique verification job ID. Import using this ID.
- `store` (String) Datastore to verify.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Non-empty comment without leading or trailing whitespace.
- `ignore_verified` (Boolean) Skip already verified snapshots unless their verification is outdated. PBS defaults to true when omitted.
- `max_depth` (Number) Namespace recursion depth; zero verifies only the selected namespace. PBS defaults to full recursion when omitted.
- `ns` (String) Backup namespace. Omit to start at the root namespace.
- `outdated_after` (Number) Days before a successful verification becomes outdated. Use a positive value to periodically recheck old backups.
- `read_threads` (Number) Chunk reader threads (1–32). PBS defaults to 1 when omitted. Requires PBS support for verification thread settings.
- `schedule` (String) PBS calendar event schedule. Omit to disable automatic runs while keeping the job.
- `verify_threads` (Number) Verification threads (1–32). PBS defaults to 4 when omitted. Requires PBS support for verification thread settings.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import proxmox_backup_server_verify_job.daily daily
```
